title: Rank cloud brain capability from comparable verified task outcomes
goal: Extend evidence-ranked brain selection to choose the strongest working cloud candidate per reasoning class using comparable held-out evaluations and actual verified outcomes with model/version, freshness and confidence. Distinguish correctness, reasoning/tool reliability and context capability from availability, cost and latency. Unknown capability is unknown; bounded authorized evaluation may establish it without invented rankings or unbudgeted paid probes. Define deterministic tie-breaking, stale evidence handling and update rules. Current failure/unfunded state excludes leadership despite historical superiority. Hermetic tests cover unknown/new models, version changes, misleading self-reports and task-specific rank changes. Implement nonzero tests named powerful_cloud_brain_ranking_* exercising production behavior.
